Chespin

Grass

Kalos · Generation 6

Chespin is a Grass-type Spiny Nut Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 9 kg. It evolves into Quilladin. Its highest base stat is Defense (65), with a base stat total of 313.
